text:
Marie (CSM): Quick flag — HorizonLabs (mid-market, ~110 seats) showing a ~39% drop in active users last 30d. Renewal in 19 days. I'm proposing a ‘salvage lane’: 9-day quick ops + 48h infra trial + a temporary seat-freeze downgrade option. Low-friction, reversible. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

Kofi (AE): I can take an exec reset Mon 10am PT. Need 1-2 crisp bullets we can promise (ex: expected token % reduction if caching turned on).

Sophie (SE): Infra note: their Dedicated cluster has KV/prefix cache disabled and a small max_batch_tokens. That matches higher token spend and some 95p latency blips. I can run a 48h canary toggle.

Sophie (SE): ```
Canary plan:
- toggle: enable prefix_cache=true on canary-pool-21
- batching: set max_batch_tokens=4096 for chat routes
- extras: enable kv_auto_prune=false to keep stable cache during test
- monitor: median/95p latency, tokens/session, error rate
- rollback: `salvage_rb.sh` to revert toggles
```

Ravi (CS Ops): I'll create a 1-question pulse after each enablement session: "Did this unblock your top issue? (Y/N)" Capture a short reason if N. Link: https://go.redwood/horizon-pulse

Ana (Product): If CS can drop 3 representative failed sessions/prompts into the shared doc, we'll repro on staging and check reranker/model mismatch. Also ask customer if they saw API errors around times X-Y.

Marie (CSM): Draft salvage lane (9 days):
- Day 0: Exec reset call + signoff for 48h canary (Kofi/Sophie)
- Days 1-4: Two 30-min hands-on office hours for power users (Sophie + Marie)
- Days 2-6: Collect up to 5 failing prompts/log snippets (Marie owns)
- Day 7: Offer a 14-day downgrade seat-freeze with data preserved OR a 10% overage credit if they commit to 6-month renewal (commercial: Kofi)

Kofi (AE): For the downgrade lane I need baseline usage (30/60/90) and last 3 invoices. Marie — can you attach? Also want a short one-liner on expected token savings to present on the call.

Marie (CSM): Pulling invoices now, will upload to the shared plan doc. Suggest we frame savings conservatively: "expected token spend reduction ~15-25% if caching enabled and batching applied".

Sophie (SE): I'll run the 48h canary starting Mon 11am PT after the exec call. Will post median/95p latency and token delta here. If token spend drops >18% that's a strong negotiation lever.

Ravi (CS Ops): I'll prep the pulse and a short enablement feedback form that ties responses into the product triage board. Also will schedule office hours slots and share Calendly.

Ana (Product): I'll standby to triage any logged prompts. If it's a model/regression issue we can repro in staging within 24-48h.

spark-bot: Meeting created — "HorizonLabs exec reset" Mon 10:00 AM PT (invite sent)

Marie (CSM): If this succeeds I'll add a compact template to micro-saves named `salvage-lane` for reuse. Next updates here after exec call and post-48h canary.
